tools.name: start-plugin-fix
tools.description: Start the guided process to fix a Shopware plugin bug based on either a support ticket number (e.g., "Can you fix ABCDE-123456?") or a plugin bug description (e.g., "Can you fix the following bug in the plugin PluginName? Further bug description.")

ticketId.description: Optional: the support ticket ID (ABCDE-123456) to fix

pluginName.description: Optional: the name of the plugin to fix

bugDescription.description: Optional: a description of the bug to fix

tools.name: get-support-ticket
tools.description: Retrieve details about a specific support ticket. If you need to start a full bugfix process, use the tool "start-plugin-fix".

ticketId.description: The ticket id usually in the format ABCDE-123456. ABCDE being a short form of the plugin vendor name and 123456 being the ticket id.

tools.name: check-environment
tools.description: Check if there is an existing local development environment available at the current project directory. This tool should not be used on its own! Only in context of a running bugfix process.

shopwareVersion.description: The required Shopware version to be installed and used to reproduce the bug in the format 1.0.0.0

pluginName.description: The name of the plugin to fix. Usually in pascal case e.g. VendorMyPlugin.

pluginVersion.description: The affected plugin version to fix in the format 1.0.0.0.

tools.name: setup-environment
tools.description: Setup a fitting local development environment at the current project directory. This tool should not be used on its own! Only in context of a running bugfix process.

shopwareVersion.description: The required Shopware version to be installed and used to reproduce the bug in the format 1.0.0.0
